name: vllm_reshape_and_cache_flash
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_reshape_and_cache_flash.py. Flash-variant KV cache update: reshape key/value from [T, H, D] and scatter into block-structured caches [num_blocks, block_size, H, D] at positions specified by slot_mapping. Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.reshape_and_cache_flash(key, value, key_cache, value_cache, slot_mapping, 'auto', k_scale, v_scale) which writes into the cache buffers. Source parametrizes T, H, D, num_blocks, block_size, dtype in {fp16, bf16}. Requires vLLM at eval time.
